stories.headline: Donald Trump's granddaughter Kai Trump reveals her unexpected song of the year pick - Fox News
stories.summary: Kai Trump revealed Adele's "Rolling in the Deep" as her song of the year in a new video, surprising fans with the classic 2010 hit as her pick.
stories.why: A Gen Z insider's nostalgia pick for a 2010 breakup anthem signals how younger women are rejecting current pop for emotional authenticity—if you're dating or marketing to women under 30, Adele's raw vulnerability is still the cultural baseline they measure against.

stories.headline: WWE SummerSlam results: Powell's live review of night two with Roman Reigns vs. Seth Rollins for the World Heavyweight Championship, Penta vs. Chad Gable for the Intercontinental Title - Pro Wrestling Dot Net
stories.why: Roman Reigns vs. Seth Rollins at SummerSlam is WWE's tentpole moment that determines which wrestler owns the main event conversation for the next six months; for guys who grew up with wrestling, this match legitimizes which storyline actually matters.

stories.headline: Jeff Goldblum Starred In An '80s Series That Nobody Talks About Today - TVLine
stories.summary: In 1980, Jeff Goldblum starred in Tenspeed and Brown Shoe, a short-lived ABC detective series that has since become a footnote in his vast filmography.
stories.why: Jeff Goldblum's forgotten '80s show reveals how even iconic actors have buried failures—relevant if you're anxious about your own missteps being permanently online, and a reminder that one failed project doesn't define a career.

stories.headline: Phil Collins Says He Almost Died in 2024 From Alcohol Abuse: ‘People Were Coming to Say Goodbye’ - Variety
stories.summary: Phil Collins says that he almost died in 2024 from health complications stemming from alcohol abuse.
stories.why: Phil Collins nearly drinking himself to death in 2024 is a wake-up call about how addiction doesn't discriminate by success or age; men 25-45 should recognize their parents' generation's substance issues as a cautionary roadmap, not a shame-free zone.

stories.headline: WWE SummerSlam 2026 results: Baron Corbin wins U.S. title from Trick Williams - Cageside Seats
stories.summary: Lil Yachty tried to help, and ended up contributing to the undoing of Trick Williams.
stories.why: Baron Corbin's U.S. title win over Trick Williams with Lil Yachty's involvement shows WWE is actively building younger rappers into storylines—a shift in who controls wrestling's cultural relevance that affects which stars actually matter in mainstream crossovers.

stories.headline: Landman' star Ali Larter shows off her fit physique in barely-there bikinis during yacht vacation in Italy - Fox News
stories.summary: Ali Larter, 50, shared stunning bikini photos from her Italian superyacht vacation, showcasing the fitness routine that keeps her camera-ready.
stories.why: Ali Larter at 50 modeling in bikinis normalizes aging out of the 'invisible woman' zone; men in this age group should notice this is the new fitness standard their partners see and aspire to, raising expectations across the board.

stories.headline: Christopher Nolan: There Is a 'Fundamental Flaw' With Film Criticism - Variety
stories.summary: Christopher Nolan says there is 'a fundamental flaw' he sees with amateur film critics.
stories.why: Nolan's critique of amateur film criticism suggests that hot takes on social media don't actually understand cinema—a direct shot at the discourse men in this demo participate in, questioning whether their streaming opinions hold any weight.
